name: v2.30.2
body:
## What's Changed
* Read and write default myclirc as UTF-8 by @b84330808 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2389
* Check every statement for the destructive warning by @shaurya703 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2390
* Bump ubuntu/wsl/.github/actions/wsl-checkout from 3b7a6b2a43af18aa541eeee1669ac27656630097 to e7fb23c6481945b25b974b6cf7a5c7f4550b6cf8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2391
* Bump pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish from 1.14.2 to 1.14.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2392
* Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.3.0 to 10.3.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2394
* Bump actions/setup-python from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2395
* Bump shogo82148/actions-setup-mysql from 1.54.2 to 1.55.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2396
* Update `cli_helpers` to v2.15.3 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2393
* Update changelog for release v2.30.2 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2397
